acceptance_predicates.description: Quiesced admission is accepted only after the exact maintenance barrier is durably held.
Barrier, owner, revision, fencing, and project identities are rechecked before and after quiescence admission.
Missing, stale, competing, or uncertain barrier state rejects admission without public mutation.

definition_of_done: Exact hostile tests cover barrier-before-admission ordering and stale/competing identity rejection.
Independent review and hosted quality/formal checks pass for one exact product revision.
Public apply, rollback, release, and Dispatch remain rejection-only; the formal model remains best-effort guidance.

inputs.description: The existing durable barrier and quiescence contracts documented by AR-0012.

outputs.description: A separately reviewable barrier-before-quiescence admission seam and hostile evidence.

gates.description: All evidence identifies one product revision.
A separate review worker passes before merge.
No public mutation path is enabled by this AR.
